text: Sorry it's so late. I'm looking after my granddaughter Rosie tonight, she's 4 months old, and I'm not sure if I'm worrying over nothing but I thought I'd better ask someone. Her temperature was 38.3 about twenty minutes ago. I think her throat might be sore, she pulls a bit of a face when she swallows, but she's still taking her bottle fine, finished most of the last one. Her mum gave her a dose of baby paracetamol before she went to work, and once that kicked in she was kicking her legs and babbling away at me like nothing was wrong, smiling and everything. It's only when it wears off that she gets a bit grizzly and warm again. I don't think it's anything serious but I've been up since five and I honestly can't think straight anymore. Also, so nobody panics when they see it: she has a bruise on her shin. That was me this afternoon at the playground. I tripped on the edge of the path with her in my arms and her leg caught the railing. I saw it happen, she cried for a second and then she was fine, and it's just the one little mark. I didn't want anyone thinking it came from something else. I suppose what I'm asking is, is it alright to just keep her comfortable and keep an eye on her tonight, or should she be seen? Thank you, and sorry again
